theorems.name: Submission.codim1_hcp_stab_perturbation_injective
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Z : Euclid P → Euclid P) (Λ t : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 Z → (∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ Z x‖ ≤ Λ) → |t| * Λ < 1 → Injective (fun x => x + t • Z x) ∧ (∀ x, fderiv ℝ (fun x => x + t • Z x) x = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid P) + t • fderiv ℝ Z x) ∧ ∀ x, Injective (fderiv ℝ (fun x => x + t • Z x) x)
